metadata.title: $G_2'$-Slodowy Slices II: Anosov Representations
metadata.abstract: We find \emph{exotic} connected components of Anosov representations of surface groups in the higher rank group $G=G_2'$ that are neither $\iota$-Fuchsian deformations nor higher rank Teichmüller spaces. These representations are found through the non-abelian Hodge correspondence via $G_2'$-Higgs bundles that we call \emph{$\alpha$-bundles} and \emph{$\beta$-bundles}, which are particular cyclic Higgs bundles in the Slodowy slices of the $\mathfrak{sl}_2$-triples associated to the simple roots $\alpha$ and $\beta$ of $\mathfrak{g}_2^{\mathbb{C}}$. We first prove that (most) $\beta$-bundles that are also Hodge bundles are $P_{\beta}$-Anosov and $\alpha$-bundles are $P_{\alpha}$-Anosov. The strategy employed is new, geometric, and general. For $\sigma \in \{\alpha, \beta\}$, we then show the locally homogeneous $(G_2', G_2'/P_{\sigma})$-manifold ${\mathscr{M}}_{\sigma}(\rho)$ recently described in arXiv:2510.12757 , for the representation $\rho:\pi_1S\rightarrow G_2'$ associated to a $\sigma$-bundle, coincides up to finite cover with the corresponding geometric structure for $\rho$ defined via domains of discontinuity by Guichard-Wienhard and Kapovich-Leeb-Porti. Consequently, we find that $\pi_1({\mathscr{M}}_{\sigma}(\rho))$ is an invariant for the connected component of $\rho$ in the space of $P_{\sigma}$-Anosov representations. After verifying the folklore result that the $G_2'$-character variety has exactly three connected components, we conclude lower bounds for the number of connected components of $P_{\sigma}$-Anosov representations in the two non-Hitchin components, most of which are exotic.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 分裂实 G₂ 的 Anosov 判据、旗几何与分支下界
analysis.workSummary: 对属 g≥2 的闭曲面，定理 A 给出多稳定 α-Higgs 丛的 Pα-Anosov 性。β 型要求 δ=0，或 α=0 且 δ 至少有一个零点。定理 B 对多稳定 σ-Hodge 丛给出从铅笔基流形到旗不连续域商的有限覆盖，β 型另要求 deg(B)≠0。附录 A 由 Hitchin 能量极小值分类得到整个 G₂′ 特征簇恰有 Hitchin、C₀、C₁ 三支。
techniques: 循环 Higgs 丛与非阿贝尔 Hodge 对应
测地流下的嵌套射影锥与特征值间隙
旗流形极限集加厚及不连续域
双覆盖基本群的有限核与圆丛中心扩张
Hitchin 能量极小值和 Stiefel–Whitney 类
analysis.breakthrough: 由无零幂零型一形式和调和度量构造嵌套射影锥，控制 Anosov 极限映射并证明发展像避开极限集加厚。双覆盖基本群的无挠商识别圆丛中心扩张，其一阶同调检测相应线丛次数。定理 E 在 C₀、C₁ 中分别给 Pα-Anosov 至少 2g−2、2g−2 支，Pβ-Anosov 至少 3g−4、3g−3 支，得到多类 exotic 分支。
analysis.limitations: 第3–4页的 β 型 Anosov 与覆盖结论各有条件，尤其 Anosov 判据保留 Hodge 型限制。第52页在奇偶计数中排除 Hitchin 端点 deg(T)=2g−2、deg(B)=6g−6，奇偶区分用于 C₀、C₁。Anosov 分支数是下界。本轮核对第3–8、15、31、34、41、43–46、51–52页的主陈述和证明路线，嵌套锥技术估计、加厚避让和能量极小值的完整逐案证明待核验。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第8页 Tool use 声明仅用 AI 查找已知数学文献并在完成后检查拼写和语法。具体找到 Remark 2.6 的 [PT07, Fin37] 以及横截性参考 [GP10]。候选元数据的 No AI proof assistance 与此范围一致。矩阵代数核对使用 Mathematica 或 Sage。
